name: Cloaked Fighting Style
body:
You are skilled at entrapping your opponent’s weapon within the confines of your cloak.

Prerequisites: Greater Disarm, Base Attack +9.

Benefit: If you are wearing a cloak and your off hand is free, you may attempt to disarm an opponent that provokes an attack of opportunity rather than making a normal attack of opportunity.
